protocol: Every outer training passenger and their three-fold-out probabilities come from the 6954 historic passengers. Both levels purge whole query bookings. The dedicated transfer retunes nothing and trains on all historic orders before scoring the 1044 entirely new passengers. No names. Four models give probabilities for budget, active services, exact amounts and additive exact amounts. The correction predicts errors of the exact-amount tree from each signed opinion, six pair gaps and proportion opposing, with that tree confidence as log-odds offset. Threshold candidates and 32 forward steps fixed. Linear control sees the same continuous inputs and offset. Raw feature coverage is identical in both corrections.
